notes: Check: (1) n=1294 'Unst (XIV.)': XIV is Pentland Skerries, but resolved as Unst (IV); check the scan. (2) n=961 'Noss': Noss Head (Caithness) vs the Isle of Noss (Shetland). (3) n=602 'Hoy Sound': given as both Hoy lights; it could be a place. (4) n=1517 'the island' and n=1479 'Arcturus': read the passages. (5) n=673 'Kincardine': Kincardine-on-Forth vs Kincardineshire. (6) n=480 'Glenboerie': guessed as Glenbervie, Larbert. (7) n=627 'Hvidenov' read as Hvítanes. (8) Unst-area places (Hermaness n=581/582, Loch of Cliff n=781, Baltasound, Haroldswick) were made places, but they probably come from the Muckle Flugga keepers. Decide whether those count as the station. (9) Lerwick (n=752) and Bressay, and Wick (n=1345) and Noss Head: check none are keeper returns. (10) Unst (n=1293) and Dunnet (n=323) were made stations, but some observations may be island-wide or village remarks. (11) Several west-coast or outside places sit in the East Coast section (Harris, Rothesay, Girvan, Rum, Lewis, Faroe names, Northumberland). These are probably miscellaneous notes, but check the section boundaries.
